# ip2region reader

Unmodified `binding/python/ip2region/{__init__.py,searcher.py,util.py}` from
https://github.com/lionsoul2014/ip2region at commit
`f8b0792b0cd729f5b2593f690aeed225e49c1967`.

Copyright 2022 The Ip2Region Authors. License: Apache-2.0 OR MIT;
full upstream license retained in `ip2region/LICENSE.md`.
We distribute this reader under Apache-2.0. Xdb datasets are downloaded separately
from the same commit by `../fetch_geoip.py`, with SHA-256 verification.
No visitor IP or analytics database is included.
